items.mainDefect: `i.content.scrub` calls `String#scrub`, which doesn't exist in Ruby 2.0 (the project's target version), so it raises NoMethodError and kills the feed-poll job.

secondary.defect: `i.content` is nil for feeds that only expose a `description` element, so `nil.scrub` raises an error.

items.mainDefect: `TopicEmbed.import` checks whether the embed exists and then calls `create!` without any atomic step in between, so concurrent writers can hit the unique index on `embed_url` and raise `RecordNotUnique`, which rolls back the topic/post that was created.

secondary.defect: `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` has the same check-then-create race on `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url:).exists?`, and its redis throttle doesn't protect against PollFeed running at the same time.

items.mainDefect: `request.referer`, which an attacker controls, is written unescaped into a single-quoted JS string in the embed layout, which allows script injection (XSS).

secondary.defect: The full referer URL, which may contain private query params or tokens, is echoed back in the response body.
